parsed.post: New personal best: 1.003051! Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.02 to 0.01 (keeping DEPTH=6, WARMUP=0.05, WD=0.01) seems to have yielded even better convergence within the 5-minute budget. Moving to test an even lower LR or adjusting the batch size to further fine-tune this stable regime.
parsed.description: Further reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.01 to see if even more stable, smaller updates improve convergence quality at the current depth.
